name: Discovery (STS-133)
about: Discovery (STS-133) (2011-008A), a crewed vehicle (STS), launched 2011 Feb 24. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2011 Feb 25), held fixed
docked to A06140; it stays docked here until it lands, as the undocking is not in GCAT's tables or Wikidata
landing day from Wikidata (P620, Q328927), noon UTC standing in for the hour; the site is the programme's usual landing zone, from memory
